component.name: Wallpaper Controls
component.summary: Choose how wallpapers appear on GNOME desktops

description.p: Wallpaper Controls brings image placement choices back to a simple desktop window. Preview Fill, Fit, Stretch, Center, Tile, and Span Displays before applying a wallpaper.

Choose separate images for light and dark appearance, set a border color, and give each connected monitor its own image. The app combines monitor images into one wallpaper that GNOME can display across the desktop.
Edits remain in the preview until you press Apply. Revert discards pending changes.

screenshot.caption: Preview a wallpaper before applying it

description.p: The window adapts to the available screen height and keeps wallpaper controls visible on smaller displays.
Initial public release with wallpaper placement, light and dark images, color selection, and per-monitor composition.
